proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13574.2 sūrya is Sanskrit sun. These sūryā/suryə forms retain the learned ry cluster rather than the regular sujja descendants; the precise path of learned circulation remains open. Exact survey form sūryā is retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11513 vādyate explicitly gives Maithili bājab to speak. The Magahi bājab infinitive matches the eastern speech sense rather than requiring a change from sound based on gloss alone. Exact survey form bājab is retained.
